The desired outputs in this notebook are images of the training and validation datasets for the two environments we considered in the *Imageable* paper: Monterrey (distritotec) and Boston. 

#### Opening the footprint data


```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import geopandas as gpd

SRC_DATA_PATH = Path("/Users/legariapena.j/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-legariapena.j@husky.neu.edu/Shared drives/Cool and Carbon Free Africa/Building Image Datasets/data")

#Ground truth Monterrey
ground_truth_monterrey_path = SRC_DATA_PATH/"monterrey"/"footprints"/"labelled_buildings_expanded.geojson"
ground_truth_monterrey = gpd.read_file(ground_truth_monterrey_path)

#All buildings Monterrey
all_buildings_path_monterrey = SRC_DATA_PATH/"monterrey"/"footprints"/"all_buildings_dedup.geojson"
all_buildings_monterrey = gpd.read_file(all_buildings_path_monterrey)

#Ground truth Boston
ground_truth_boston_path = SRC_DATA_PATH/"boston"/"footprints"/"labelled_buildings_meters.geojson"
ground_truth_boston = gpd.read_file(ground_truth_boston_path)

#All buildings Boston
all_buildings_path_boston = SRC_DATA_PATH/"boston"/"footprints"/"boston_buildings.geojson"
all_buildings_boston = gpd.read_file(all_buildings_path_boston)


batches_names = ["1-1000","1000-2000","2000-3000", "3000-4000", "4000-5000", "5000-6000", "6000-7000", "7000=8000", "8000-9000", "9000-10000"]
#Open all Monterrey feature GeoJSONs (batches)
monterrey_geojsons = {}
for i in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26]:
    if(i == 0):
        first_index = i*1000+1
    else:
        first_index = i*1000

    second_index = (i+1)*1000
    first_string = "Images "+f"{first_index} - {second_index}"
    file_path = SRC_DATA_PATH/"monterrey_dedup"/first_string/f"building_data_{first_index}_{second_index}.geojson"
    monterrey_geojsons[f"{first_index}-{second_index}"] = gpd.read_file(file_path)

boston_geojsons = {}
for i in range(10):
    if(i == 0):
        first_index = i*1000+1
    else:
        first_index = i*1000

    second_index = (i+1)*1000
    first_string = "Images "+f"{first_index} - {second_index}"
    file_path = SRC_DATA_PATH/"boston"/first_string/f"building_data_{first_index}_{second_index}.geojson"
    boston_geojsons[batches_names[i]] = gpd.read_file(file_path)

#Now we simply merge the GeoJSONs
import pandas as pd
gdf_monterrey = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    pd.concat(monterrey_geojsons, ignore_index=True),
    crs=monterrey_geojsons[list(monterrey_geojsons.keys())[0]].crs
)

gdf_boston = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    pd.concat(boston_geojsons, ignore_index=True),
    crs=boston_geojsons[list(boston_geojsons.keys())[0]].crs
)

gdf_all = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    pd.concat([gdf_monterrey, gdf_boston], ignore_index=True),
    crs=gdf_boston.crs
)

gdf_all.head(5)

```


### Differentiating between training and validation

We open the train/val data file, which contains information about which instances were selected for validation and which for training per city. 

```{python}

import json

DICTIONARIES_PATH = "/Users/legariapena.j/Documents/imageable-2026/imageable/data/training_validation_data/data.json"

with open(DICTIONARIES_PATH) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

#IDs Monterrey
ids_monterrey_data = [x["building_id"] for x in data if x["city"] == "Monterrey"]
#IDs Boston
ids_boston_data = [x["building_id"] for x in data if x["city"] == "Boston"]
#Data types (train vs. val) Monterrey
data_type_monterrey = {x["building_id"]: x["data_type"] for x in data if x["city"] == "Monterrey"}
#Data types (train vs. val) Boston
data_type_boston = {x["building_id"]: x["data_type"] for x in data if x["city"] == "Boston"}

gdf_monterrey_data = gdf_monterrey[gdf_monterrey["building_id"].isin(ids_monterrey_data)]
gdf_boston_data = gdf_boston[gdf_boston["building_id"].isin(ids_boston_data)]

#Now we tag according to the data type
gdf_monterrey_data["data_type"] = [data_type_monterrey[b] for b in gdf_monterrey_data["building_id"]]
gdf_boston_data["data_type"] = [data_type_boston[b] for b in gdf_boston_data["building_id"]]

```

### Plot Monterrey

Let's use `display_footprints_categorical` to display the training and validation buildings for Monterrey. 

```{python}
#We can now add all buildings that are not in the training/validation set as unlabelled data
ground_truth_monterrey = ground_truth_monterrey.to_crs(gdf_monterrey_data.crs)
ground_truth_monterrey["data_type"] = "Not in either"
monterrey_labels = ground_truth_monterrey["building_id"].map(data_type_monterrey)
ground_truth_monterrey.loc[monterrey_labels.notna(), "data_type"] = monterrey_labels.dropna()

from imageable.visualization.footprints_2d import display_footprints_categorical

import os

CARTO_API_KEY = os.environ.get("CARTO_API_KEY")

DRACULA_PINK = "#ff79c6"
DRACULA_CYAN = "#8BE9FD"
DRACULA_COMMENT = "#6272a4"

plot_mty = ground_truth_monterrey.copy()
plot_mty["data_type"] = pd.Categorical(
    plot_mty["data_type"],
    categories=["train", "validation", "Not in either"],
    ordered=True,
)
plot_mty = plot_mty.sort_values("data_type")

n_train = (plot_mty["data_type"] == "train").sum()
n_val = (plot_mty["data_type"] == "validation").sum()
n_other = (plot_mty["data_type"] == "Not in either").sum()

display_footprints_categorical(
    gdf=plot_mty,
    column="data_type",
    colors=[DRACULA_PINK, DRACULA_CYAN, DRACULA_COMMENT],
    base_gdf=all_buildings_monterrey,
    title="Monterrey",
    subtitle=f"Training: {n_train:,}    Validation: {n_val:,}    Discarded: {n_other:,}",
    title_y=1.16,
    subtitle_y=1.05,
    annotate_counts=False,
    focus_on_gdf_bounds=True,
    add_basemap=True,
    basemap_source = "CartoDB.Positron",
    basemap_api_key = CARTO_API_KEY,
    width = 7,
    height = 7,
    save_path = "/Users/legariapena.j/Documents/imageable-2026/imageable/data/paper_images/train_validation_monterrey.jpg"
)

```


### Plot Boston
And now let's show the training and validation sets for Boston. 

```{python}
ground_truth_boston = ground_truth_boston.to_crs(gdf_boston_data.crs)
ground_truth_boston["data_type"] = "Not in either"

indices_boston_local = [int(b.split("_")[-1]) - 1 for b in ids_boston_data]
boston_data_types = [data_type_boston[b] for b in ids_boston_data]
ground_truth_boston.loc[indices_boston_local, "data_type"] = boston_data_types

plot_boston = ground_truth_boston.copy()
plot_boston["data_type"] = pd.Categorical(
    plot_boston["data_type"],
    categories=["train", "validation", "Not in either"],
    ordered=True,
)
plot_boston = plot_boston.sort_values("data_type")

n_train_boston = (plot_boston["data_type"] == "train").sum()
n_val_boston = (plot_boston["data_type"] == "validation").sum()
n_other_boston = (plot_boston["data_type"] == "Not in either").sum()

display_footprints_categorical(
    gdf=plot_boston,
    column="data_type",
    colors=[DRACULA_PINK, DRACULA_CYAN, DRACULA_COMMENT],
    base_gdf=all_buildings_boston,
    title="Boston",
    subtitle=f"Training: {n_train_boston:,}    Validation: {n_val_boston:,}    Discarded: {n_other_boston:,}",
    title_y=1.20,
    subtitle_y=1.05,
    annotate_counts=False,
    focus_on_gdf_bounds=True,
    add_basemap=True,
    basemap_source = "CartoDB.Positron",
    basemap_api_key = CARTO_API_KEY,
    width=12,
    height=5,
    buffer_meters = 4,
    save_path="/Users/legariapena.j/Documents/imageable-2026/imageable/data/paper_images/train_validation_boston.jpg",
)
```
